agent_blocked_on.issue: scan.json field `lowercase_in_target` is meaningless — it is True for every token that appears in the transcript at all.
agent_blocked_on.detail: batch_scan.py:132 reads the target and calls .lower() on the whole text, then line 147 searches that lowercased text for the lowercased token. The match therefore always succeeds regardless of the token's real casing. Following the brief's rule ('if it is true, recommend no_rule') literally would have turned all 155 members into no_rule and destroyed the pass.
agent_blocked_on.what_i_did: Left the scanner's field untouched and added `lowercase_in_target_recomputed`, computed correctly against the post-apply preview text (case-insensitive whole-word search, True only when some occurrence has a lowercase initial letter). Recommendations use the recomputed value.
agent_blocked_on.needs: Orchestrator should fix batch_scan.py (compare against the original-cased text) before the next wave, and decide whether to trust my recomputed field.

kind_conventions: campaign_correct_name: sibling spells a known campaign name at the span. Two members (Orcic, Velfinus) use it where the sibling gives a form that is REGISTERED as a wrong-form of the canonical in notes/vtt_transcription_corrections.md (Orsick->Orsik, Velfina->Valphine); that identifies the entity even though the spelling is not canonical. Each says so in its rationale.

ordinary_words: sibling shows plain, non-campaign text at the span — including real-world proper nouns both transcriptions agree on (Bay Area, Austin, Cthulhu, Google Chat). Those are surfaced with `ignore` rather than auto-dismissed, because they are proper nouns the GM may want on the real-world/table list.

different_name: reserved for the contamination failure mode — sibling substitutes a DIFFERENT recognisable name. A sibling that merely garbles the same name into a non-name (Melfino, Mukrudin, Velphi, Velfanar) is classed `inconclusive`, not `different_name`; garble is not substitution.
inconclusive: sibling score < 0.55, span not covered, or sibling garbles the same name.
agent_notes.sibling_health: This chapter's sibling is contaminated in the documented way: it spells Brewbarry as 'Brewberry' throughout, renders Valphine as Velfina / Velfanar / Dalfine / Melfino, and substitutes 'Akritas' and 'Earthcorp'. It IS reliable on ordinary prose and it spelled Zhentarim, Adabra, Phandalin, Halberd and Whispering Wood correctly, which is where its four confirmations come from.
